text:
Stop thinking everyone is watching you. They're not.

It's Friday. Group chat is alive. You're home alone, reading but not typing.

That's isolation. It whispers a lie: everyone judges you, finds you lacking. So you hide more.

Here's the truth. Almost no one thinks about you. Your coworker worries about his job. That girl worries about her phone. Everyone is too busy to judge you.

So today, shift off yourself. Ask about other people. Listen. Make them feel valued. That kills isolation.

They're not judging you. You're too focused on yourself.
caption:
Self improvement for men: shift your mindset from impressing people to genuine connection. Success in dating follows.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
